Gold.note: Central bank accumulation and rate cut expectations offset recent historical pullback.

Silver.note: Robust solar panel demand and monetary premium support recovery from oversold levels.

Copper.note: Tight mine supply and green transition needs balance soft near-term Chinese demand.

Uranium.note: Structural primary supply deficit and accelerating global nuclear reactor build-outs.

Lithium.note: Persistent market oversupply and moderating EV battery demand growth.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply growth outpacing sluggish stainless steel demand.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and smelter treatment charge squeezes support refined prices.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in Chinese property sector and elevated port inventories.

Coal.note: Adequate global seaborne inventories and long-term energy transition headwinds.

Rare Earths.note: Strategic supply restrictions and long-term EV motor demand offset near-term softness.

Manganese.note: Stable traditional steel demand balances emerging battery-grade premium opportunities.

PGM.note: Structural decline in internal combustion engines offsets hydrogen and substitution demand.

Potash.note: Normalized global supply chains and steady baseline agricultural application rates.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and strong lightweighting demand in automotive sectors.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper growth and resilient iron ore cash flows.
